value.rationale: A natural square Gaussian Ritz sketch is almost surely defined yet has infinite squared compression risk for any nonzero residual. The entrywise median of exactly three independent realizations repairs this mathematically consequential robustness deficit and exactly matches the risk obtainable by increasing the sketch height by one. The equality is uniform over all complex matrices, nonnormal matrices and trial spaces, and quantifies a practical robustness-versus-computation tradeoff without claiming overall eigenpair or computational-cost improvement.
